component.name: code-snippet
component.description: Displays formatted code content in a bordered card. Supports a multi-line variant with language tabs, line numbers, copy button, and show-more expansion; and a single-line variant for inline terminal commands.

variants.name: Type=Multi-Line
variants.description: Multi-line code block with horizontal language tab bar, gutter with line numbers, code body, inline copy button, and show-more button.

variants.name: Type=Single-Line
variants.description: Single-line inline terminal command with optional prompt keyword and copy button.

tab_active.description: Selected language tab with green bottom indicator and bold weight.

expanded.description: Code block is expanded; line clamp is removed.

implementation_notes: Tab bar uses native role=tablist / role=tab pattern. Active tab is aria-selected=true.
Tab divider (gray bar) and tab active indicator (green bar) are ::after pseudo-elements.
Line numbers are aria-hidden=true — presentational only.
Code content is inside <pre><code> for semantic correctness.
Copy button is an icon-only Button component instance. aria-label='Copy code' required.
Show More button uses aria-expanded toggled by JS.
Single-line variant uses .code-snippet--single modifier on root.
All --code-snippet-* tokens are proposed and must be added to token.css.
No syntax highlighting is included. Plain monospace rendering only.
Keyboard navigation between tabs must be handled by component JS (arrow keys).

discarded_axes.reason: Manifest does not show an explicit RTL variant. IBM Plex Sans Arabic font is referenced which implies RTL readiness, but no CSS delta exists. Discarded.
No size axis in manifest. Code snippet does not vary by size.
No dark/light theme axis in manifest. Single surface color only.
